newsitem.title: GREECE: Ecu/drachma firms, O/N depo drops, forwards stable.
newsitem.headline: Ecu/drachma firms, O/N depo drops, forwards stable.

text.p: The ecu/drachma was firmer on some ecu buying for drachmas from abroad, overnight depos were trading 10 to 20 basis points lower and implied drachma rates were holding but for an uptick in one-week to two-month tenors, dealers said.
"Ecu/drachma is trading around 307.75/85 right now after hitting 307.90/00 earlier on some ecu buying for drachma from abroad," said a dealer at a foreign bank.
A 7.4 percent, three-year $-linked bond worth about $267 million is expiring today, dealers said.
"I expect some banks to come out and buy some $, marks and ecus at today's fixing," said a forex dealer at another foreign bank.
NatWest said in its flash report on forex markets that mark/drachma was biased on the upside if it broke strong resistance at 157.50/60 targeting the 159 level.
Money market dealers said overnight funds were trading 10 to 20 basis points lower with the rest of the yield curve holding.
"Implied drachma rates are little changed but one-week to two-month rates are slightly up," said a dealer at a private bank.
Bond dealers said trading activity was subdued and prices unmoved.
The mark was quoted at 157.45/55 from Thursday's 157.210 fix, the dollar at 270.52/62 drachmas from 271.680 and the ecu at 307.80/90 from 307.440 drachmas.
